name: Dr Seuss's Wacky Wednesday
summary: In an otherwise perfectly normal town, whenever Wednesday rolls around things suddenly get wacky! Luckily, this town has a ten-year-old Wacky Expert who knows that humor inspires creativity and never fails to solve every wacky problem with an equally wacky solution.

name: Bloomberg Wealth with David Rubenstein
summary: David Rubenstein learns key investment strategies and tactics from a high-profile roster of professional investing luminaries.

name: Guts & Glory
summary: Guts & Glory flips the script on the traditional competition show - thrusting players into an immersive horror experience full of unexpected challenges. The new series blends the intensity of a horror film with the pressure of a survival game where contestants are confronted with their fears in various scenarios.

name: High Tackle
summary: Gabby Logan hosts High Tackle, a Six Nations comedy quiz with Eddie Butler captaining a team of Welsh celebrities as they tackle their counterparts from the other nations.

name: Митрич
summary: Anastasia, a psychologist, and Viktor, the head of the cosmodrome, are conducting an experiment: will the team be able to cope with a two-year flight to Mars? Experienced cosmonaut Kovalev, his ex-wife and physician Natalia, biologist Oksana, flight engineer Platon and Chinese cosmonaut Wei do not even realize that they will spend two years not in space, but in the pavilion. Everything goes according to plan, until Mitrich accidentally turns up at the cosmodrome...

name: Inside Melbourne Airport
summary: Inside Melbourne Airport takes viewers behind the scenes of Australia's busiest 24-hour airport. With over 35 million passengers moving through its terminals each year, the team work around the clock to manage complex challenges – from flight delays, tight turnarounds, runway maintenance, baggage mishaps and flight emergencies. It's up to the dedicated team to make split-second decisions that keep the airport running safely and smoothly and on time.

name: Knowitalls
summary: Gyles Brandreth presents the quiz without questions. Contestants have their breadth of knowledge tested to the limit as they battle it out to impress the show's experts.

name: Clever v Stupid
summary: Matt Edmondson presents a game show using games based on psychological research. The show tests the teams' creativity, emotional intelligence, physical dexterity and practical skills.

name: Engineering Europe
summary: This series reveals the extraordinary secrets of Europe's engineering wonders. Filmed across six great nations, it will explore record-breaking construction projects, innovative machines and vehicles, and ingenious design. It will also reveal the hidden engineering that drives Europe's most iconic landmarks and the people who keep them working today.

name: Global Eye
summary: Award-winning investigations - revealing secrets, rooting out injustice, and exposing crime, corruption, and abuse. The biggest stories from BBC correspondents all over the world.

name: Whose Coat is That Jacket?
summary: Chris Corcoran chairs a comedy quiz about Wales and Welsh life. Showing as part of the BBC Wales Real Valleys season.

name: The Really Welsh Quiz
summary: A festive quiz with a strong Welsh connection. Chris Corcoran is in the chair alongside team captains comedian Elis James and chair of Radio 4's The News Quiz, Miles Jupp.

name: Jonathan's Six Nations Quiz
summary: Jonathan Davies presents a rugby quiz in which teams of celebrities and players take on supporters from the Welsh rugby regions.

name: The Big Finish
summary: Graham Norton and guests look back at the year.

name: Moordzaken Liefde Is Geen Alibi
summary: When love, jealousy and hate form a gruesome cocktail, things go wrong... Reconstructions of murder cases in the relationship sphere.

name: Vitaminix
summary: This season covers the nutritional value of an average person's daily food intake in the most fun way. It shows the careful segregation of the mineral value of every food item, coupled with interesting facts of the effect of it on other livings beings that consume it. From the natural abilities of monkeys to swing from one tree to another to lions tearing meat, food has never been more exciting.

name: Kooiboys
summary: Traveling through different countries, Pedro Elias and Robin Pront train for one year for a real cage fight. Along the way, they discover the origin and values of various fighting disciplines.

name: Tonnano
summary: After the birth of his son, Tonnano wants to leave his criminal past behind and build an honest life in the Achterhoek region, where his girlfriend Amani and her family live. His arrival causes unrest among the notorious Eysinck drug family. Amani's uncle turns out to owe debts to this family, and Tonnano is drawn back into the underworld.

name: Into The Void: Life, Death & Heavy Metal
summary: Into The Void explores the epic struggles and the cultural impacts made by heavy metal's most compelling artists. Their intensely personal stories about finding success offer a unique combination of volume and distortion through tales of murder, addiction, rebellion, and redemption.

name: The Tech Bro Murders
summary: The pressure of Silicon Valley turns dreamers dark, as Lt. Sandra Brown uncovers murdered tech tycoons and millionaire killers.

name: Намасте, Магадан!
summary:
One of the engines of the plane flying from Delhi to San Francisco failed, and the airliner had to make an emergency landing at Magadan airport. Now passengers and crew members are forced to spend an indefinite amount of time in the harsh northern capital of Kolyma. Sending foreigners to their homeland is an almost impossible task. It is impossible to send another plane for the guests because of the destroyed runway during the emergency landing. 

The only salvation is the locals, who cordially help foreigners in trouble and accommodate guests at the nearest school. It is here that the difficult everyday life of American business class passengers, colorful Indians and a young Indian IT specialist Vasant will take place.

name: Взятка
summary:
Elena is the director of the most prestigious gymnasium in the city. In her youth, she experienced betrayal by her beloved man and best friend, lost her child and gave up on her personal life, preferring to build a career. One day, a former friend approaches her with a request to arrange for her daughter Olya. Lena barely recognizes her - her husband died, the rest of the money is spent on fighting a serious illness. Lena succumbs to temptation and agrees to arrange for the girl to go to the gymnasium for a large bribe - this is retribution for Sonya's betrayal.

A friend sells an old family ring and gives Lena a bribe. From this moment on, events begin to develop completely unpredictably, dramatically and unexpectedly, involving more and more new people. Elena will have to correct her own mistakes, learn to forgive, trust people and find her love.

name: Michael Palin in Venezuela
summary:
Michael Palin's latest epic journey is to often troubled but little explored Venezuela, a huge and once oil rich country that has been called the most dangerous in South America; under authoritarian rule, financially in meltdown and facing massive social challenges from this economic collapse. But it is also one of the most beautiful places in the world where visitors are few and awe-inspiring regions remain unexplored.

When Michael arrives, Venezuela is still reeling from the controversial re-election of Nicolás Maduro as President, a man whose style is often more showbiz or self-styled superhero than presidential. Economic turmoil has led eight million people to flee the country in the last ten years. But Venezuela also has the longest Caribbean coast, the world's tallest waterfall and the Andes mountains; it should be on every traveller's wish list. From Caracas to the Amazon rainforest and the Caribbean Sea, Michael embarks on a thrilling, if sometimes risky, adventure into a dystopian Paradise.

name: Situações Delicadas
summary: Olivia, Marta, and Carlota are three friends leading normal lives, until a moment of panic changes everything: an unexpected confrontation with Olivia's ex-boyfriend, Jaime, ends tragically when he accidentally dies. Consumed by the fear of losing their freedom during the best years of their lives, the three make a radical decision: to hide the body and conceal what happened that night. What begins as an act of desperation quickly devolves into an uncontrollable spiral of lies, improvised crimes, and growing paranoia. Between loose ends, unexpected mistakes, and the constant threat of discovery, they plunge into a series of crimes that become increasingly difficult to justify.

previousepisode.name: Veneno de rato, vende-se em supermercados

name: Мотив преступления
summary: The project "Motive of Crime" is a story of crimes committed on the basis of jealousy, revenge or unrequited love. The participants of the events are not superheroes, but ordinary people, like you and me, and because of this, the events that unfold in each episode of the series become especially interesting and close, touching to the quick. Alexander Polovtsev, an experienced TV detective, tells the viewer about "Motive of Crime". He confidently leads the viewer through the twists and turns of a complex plot, reporting more and more new details, until he finally finds out the main thing - who the killer is and what the motive for the crime was.

name: Britain's Railway Empire in Colour
summary: To mark the 200th anniversary of the birth of rail, Britain's Railway Empire in Colour reveals the extraordinary story of how Britain gave railways to the world – from the first tentative experiments with steam power, through the boom years at home, to the exporting of this new technology to every corner of the globe. Using leading experts and enthusiasts, including TikTok trainspotter Francis Bourgeois, plus extensive newly colourised archive, the truly revolutionary invention and impact of the locomotive is explored.

name: Michael Portillo's 200 Years of the Railways
summary:
September 2025 marks 200 years since the first steam-hauled passenger train ran on a public railway, from Stockton to Darlington, in 1825. To celebrate this incredible anniversary, Michael Portillo is set to take audiences on a journey through time with: 200 Years of The Railways.

The series will see Michael Portillo travel by train to the Northeast and Northwest of England and investigate what the railways have done for us over the past 200 years and explore what the railways' role could be in the future.

name: Alaca
summary: A young girl's life is turned upside down when her kidney is stolen during a violent kidnapping, orchestrated by her rich biological father who needs a donor.

name: Nadia's Farm Kitchen
summary: After 6 years of finding her feet on the farm Nadia Lim is diving back into her kitchen to create a mouth-watering collection of exciting new dishes inspired by food sourced from Royalburn Station and all over the deep south.

name: Brainbox Challenge
summary: Clive Anderson hosts a brain training quiz show in which contestants battle to prove themselves in a sequence of brain games which test their memory, language, visual, numerical and spacial skills.

name: Battle of the Brains
summary: Two teams featuring some of the brightest brains in Britain go head-to-head in a game of nerve, strategy and skill.

name: Technické památky českých zemí
summary: Unique technological landmarks in individual regions of the Czech Republic. What traces have they left in the landscape?

name: Crisis at the Castle
summary: Crisis at the Castle is a series about aristocratic families trying to save their homes.

name: Aynadaki Yabancı
summary: Azra's story begins like a fairytale, but her life quickly turns into a nightmare. As the daughter-in-law of the Karaaslan family, she lives a seemingly perfect life, but behind this splendor lurks dark secrets. Forced to pay a heavy price while trying to escape with her daughter, Azra finds only one way to reunite with her: to change her face and return to that house as someone else. On this journey, she meets the successful plastic surgeon Barış Saygıner, and on the operating table, he rewrites not only her face but also her destiny. However, the shadows of the past and an impossible love will be Azra's greatest test.

name: They Sold a Million
summary: The stories behind the Welsh music legends who sold a million records.

name: Enfes Bir Akşam
summary: The delicate balance between love and power are shaken up when a self-made businessman and a rival yacht designer are swept up in a captivating romance.

name: Agent 203
summary: When 13-year-old Zoe Strannek discovers her dad was a secret agent fighting aliens, she must step into his role as Agent 203 to protect Earth from a menacing intergalactic warlord, all while navigating the ups and downs of middle school.

name: Dog Park
summary: When Roland's wife Emma leaves him with their teenage daughter Mia who barely notices him and Beattie, the dog he never wanted in the first place, he's determined to cope brilliantly. But when Beattie disappears and turns up at the local dog park, Roland meets the unbearably optimistic Samantha and her mismatched, life-loving group of dog-parkers. As Roland begrudgingly keeps returning to the park, he comes to realise he might actually need a community to belong to.

name: Omagh - The Legacy
summary: Poignant documentaries following two survivors of the 1998 Omagh bombing, narrated by Liam Neeson.

name: The Dangerous Convenience Store
summary: Yeo Euijoon, who works at a convenience store under frequent threats from gangsters, spends his days in fear, but even so he cannot afford to quit his job, after all, the salary is much higher than in other stores. One day, Euijoon, in danger, is saved by the sudden appearance of Beom Gunwoo. Buying the same things every day, the cashier becomes curious about his savior-customer and... Wait, he lives in the apartment next door?!

name: Beauty and the Brawn
summary: Haeun is a nobleman who falls hard for Dullseh, his gorgeous, but extremely clueless manservant. Dullseh's impressive build reminds Haeun of the sexy men from gay erotica that he loves so much. Exams and career ambitions be damned—he just can't get Dullseh out of his mind! Silly hijinks ensue as Haeun will do whatever it takes to lure the hunky Dullseh into his bedchamber and possibly... his heart?!

name: Jebal Joyonghi Jom Hae!
summary:
One month into living on his own, Yi-hyuk was hoping for an exciting, dramatic start to his independent life—but not this kind of drama. What he doesn't expect is to be tormented by the thunderous noise coming from the apartment next door.

Determined to put an end to it, he confronts his neighbor—only to make things infinitely worse when he accidentally punches him in the face.

Yi-hyuk tries everything—from childish pranks to petty power plays—but his neighbor just won't budge. He even pleads on his knees to make the noise stop. Just when it seems the feud will never end, they finally manage to call an uneasy truce.

And somewhere along the way, Yi-hyuk realizes he might be falling for the very person who once drove him up the wall.

name: Koi no Yu♨️Talk
summary: Chibi shorts for Babanbabanban Vampire that were published on the official Twitter and YouTube accounts for the series.

name: Shitasaki kara Koi
summary: The story revolves around the "cakeverse," in which people are categorized as "forks" and "cakes." Tatsunari is a "fork," who has lost his taste for people, except for "cakes." Naruya is a "cake," who is specifically scrumptious for "forks."

name: Osmanlida Derin Devlet
summary: In 1711, the Ottoman Empire defeated the Russian Empire and entered a period of stagnation. The story begins with Patrona Halil's brother hanging with the order of the sultan. The Ottomans got away from the war and organized more fun in the tulips gardens. The opponents of the Janissaries and some anti-Sultan gangs trying to organize can not dare a rebel.

name: Bongchon Bride
summary:
"You bought me for 50 sacks of rice? Why would you do that?"

"I thought you might end up dead if I didn't."

Hidden deep in the mountains from prying eyes, the burly Bong-chun lives in seclusion.

Bong-chun buys and rescues Sun-gap, a servant boy who is beaten almost to death by his master. Sun-gap is bewildered by Bong-chun, who treats him with unexpected kindness, calling him his wife and not putting him to any hard work.

As Sun-gap begins to enjoy the peace with Bong-chun, feeling relieved to have finally escaped his old master's house, a man appears, claiming he has come to take him back.

name: After Action
summary: Hosted by retired Air Force combat photographer Stacy Pearsall, the acclaimed PBS series After Action offers a powerful, inside look at what life is like before, during and after action through candid conversations with veterans from around the country. By sharing her own struggles with reintegrating into civilian life, Pearsall encourages fellow veterans to delve deeper into their personal stories, fostering a greater understanding and appreciation for those who have served. The series seeks to demystify the military experience, spark dialogue among family members and preserve military stories, many of which remain untold.

name: Grown Ups
summary: Set in south county Dublin, Grown Ups follows the chaotic lives of the Casey clan, a noisy, tight-knit Irish family, who are bound together by a tangled web of loyalty, resentment, money, memory, and love. When the rock of the family, the "good son," dies unexpectedly, it sets off a seismic emotional reckoning. Over the course of the next year, the Caseys will fall in and out of love, confront old wounds and make some new ones. They'll be forced to face not only their grief, but the exhausting, relentless, and often ridiculous struggle of being an adult. Despite their age and responsibilities, the Caseys are far from grown up.

name: The Detection Club
summary: The Detection Club, set in 1930s London, the golden age of detective fiction, sees the mysterious society of the three most famous crime writers of our time Agatha Christie, Dorothy L. Sayers and G.K. Chesterton, join forces to solve real-life murders. Honing their craft within the hallowed walls of a secret London location, the three writers come together after receiving an invitation that leads them to their first real murder case. The series follows the trio as they work together to crack cases, all to the despair of D.I. Greenway a young, rookie, real-life detective.

name: The Hairdresser Mysteries
summary: The Hairdresser Mysteries is a nostalgic nod to the 70s which sees a high-end hairdresser, Lily Petal, opt out of the competitive city scene to buy a small village hairdressers at the top of a cobbled street. Everyone tells their hairdresser everything and soon she is at the hub of her new village's secrets and revelations, and with her own brand of uncannily highly developed, hairdressing intuitive empathy and understanding, solves the village mysteries.

name: Beauty and the Bester
summary: In this intense documentary series, renowned Dr Nandipha Magudumana is entangled in Thabo Bester's prison break — but is she an accomplice or a victim?

name: 80 Jie Mei De Jiao Huan Ren Sheng
That Thrifting Show With Lara Spencer
summary: In the 12-episode series, vintage design expert Lara Spencer presents two designer duos with identical rooms. With limited time and budget, teams must treasure hunt for vintage and thrift store finds to design their way to beautiful, layered, finished rooms. It's style and sustainability in a race against the clock.

name: Money Money Come
summary: Chen Gongxi, the unassuming owner of a teahouse in Beimen Alley, is actually a hidden Mahjong master. When a corporate rivalry intensifies, three women seek him out, urging him to return to the scene. To protect the vibrant life of the old street, he joins forces with his confidante to battle the schemes of a business tycoon. Amidst the deceptive Mahjong games, the young prodigy repeatedly turns the tide, saving the community from crisis. Just as he is about to win the beauty's heart, a long-buried truth about his past unexpectedly emerges...

name: El Dentista
summary: El Dentista follows Nolasco Black, a forensic dentist investigating the brutal murder of a prostitute. As he digs deeper into the case, he relives a personal tragedy and uncovers evidence that Jack the Ripper has arrived in America. With the support of the secret society Flammarion and Sofía, a brilliant chemist who becomes both his ally and love interest, Nolasco embarks on a dangerous hunt to stop the killer before more victims fall.

name: Saturday in America
summary: Featuring conversations with newsmakers across the political landscape, Saturday in America with Kayleigh McEnany will provide a comprehensive look at the headlines dominating the news cycle.

name: The Sunday Briefing
summary: The Sunday Briefing will tackle all facets of the White House beat, including the President of the United States' national and international moves as well as the key issues impacting the administration.

name: Fox & Friends Weekend
summary: Early risers get a chance to experience their own news, information and entertainment that "FOX and Friends" viewers get during the week with this weekend version of the show. In addition to reporting and discussion of the latest news, the show features weather forecasts to help viewers plan their weekend activities.

name: Neil Morrissey: Care Home Kid
summary: Neil Morrissey was just 10-years-old when he was sent into care. He looks back at his childhood in the hope of learning how this experience has truly affected him as an adult.

name: Winx Club: The Magic is Back
summary: When Bloom discovers she has magic, her life takes a wild turn. At Alfea, a school for fairies and witches, she meets five girls who become her best friends. Together, they're the Winx.

name: Bishop
summary: Homicide detective Bishop Graves – brilliant, battle-scarred – will put all of his skills to the test in the hunt for an elusive killer targeting San Francisco's moneyed class. As this increasingly audacious killer develops a devoted following among the city's powerless, Bishop becomes convinced these murders connect back to SF's most powerful man, his own father, Lincoln Graves.

name: Eli's Places
summary: Eli Manning will host Eli's Places, a college football centric expansion of the Peyton's Places franchise, on ESPN+. Join the 2-time Super Bowl MVP as he takes on his own version of his brother's signature show to explore what makes college football a way of life across the country. Eli will travel to some of the most well-known and historic college football establishments and meet with giants in the sport to better understand what makes college football such a national sensation.

name: Typhoon Family
summary: A rookie boss inherits his father's business. An ambitious bookkeeper dreams of success. Together, they learn entrepreneurship and adulthood amid crisis.

previousepisode.name: We Met the Bluebird, and Life Goes On

name: Would You Marry Me?
summary: A sweet and thrilling, 90-day fake honeymoon survival romantic comedy about a man and a woman who are trying to win the ultimate newlywed prize.

name: Last Summer
summary: A work that depicts a three-dimensional romance between a woman who 'hates summer' and a man who 'waits for summer every day' as they reunite after two years. The two people who complete their romance by examining each other from the inside out will unfold against the backdrop of summer.

name: Danny Will Die Alone
summary: Danny is looking for love in all the right places, but finding all the wrong people. Born out of creator Jack Tracy's own post-pandemic dating life, this unabashedly jaw-dropping and proudly judgmental comedy series follows one single man through the hell-scape of gay courtship in New York City – where he screws his way through the apps in an increasingly desperate search for his one true love.

name: Victoria Beckham
summary: From stage school wannabe to superstar, the former Spice Girl looks back on her life as she prepares to show her brand's latest collection in Paris.

name: Los Mufas: suerte para la desgracia
summary: In Los Mufas: suerte para la desgracia, Roque, a paranormal journalist, teams up with the most dangerous "mufa" in Argentina, Vicente, to conduct an investigation that will change the course of his life. They both want to find a solution to this phenomenon that affects certain people, involuntarily and inexplicably producing ruins and storms around them. However, Roque's powerful, multimillionaire boss doesn't want this report to come to light. In return, he offers Roque an unusual assignment, in exchange for a large sum of money: to free his daughter from a "mufa cult" and save her from the clutches of a perverse and psychopathic parapsychologist. Although Roque's path seems to be uphill, the adventures he experiences with Vicente will give meaning to his life again and help him heal family wounds from yesterday and today.

name: Always, Lady London
summary: Always, Lady London takes fans inside the defining chapter of Lady London's career: the making of her debut album, To Whom It May Concern. With a major-label release and worldwide tour on the line and while facing grief, doubt, and the relentless pressure to deliver - she is determined to prove she's more than a viral moment.

name: The Friday the 13th Murders
summary: The Friday the 13th Murders which explores dark and twisted cases that occurred on the calendar's most feared date - Friday the 13th.

name: Tang Detective: The Broken Mirror Conspiracy
Time Reveals the Prince's Heart
summary: In the early Republic of China, Qian Yiyu, the adopted daughter of Qian Fan—the old butler of the wealthy Liu family—grew up as childhood sweethearts with Liu Sinan, the second young master, and the two were engaged to be married. However, on the night of their wedding, she was suddenly forced to marry Liu Silin, Liu Sinan's deranged elder brother. Resentful toward the man who took the place of her beloved, Yiyu must still pretend everything is fine—for she has a secret mission: to help Liu Sinan spy on his brother. It turns out that the elder brother's downfall was orchestrated by Liu Sinan himself, who seeks to seize the entire family fortune. Yet, despite Yiyu's hostility and defiance, Liu Silin treats her with patience and tenderness. As Yiyu continues to watch over him, she is gradually moved by his kindness, and love quietly blossoms between them. But their fragile affection is constantly tested by manipulation and deceit—eventually uncovering the shocking truth behind the murder of Yiyu's biological parents.

name: 3 Seconds to You
summary: Disgraced former film queen Lin Zhiyu has the ability to foresee a person's next thirty days through brief skin contact. After predicting that her one-night stand, Shen Youchuan, will kill her, she flees in fear—only to become repeatedly entangled with him. Torn between escaping a foretold death and fighting to reclaim her career, Lin Zhiyu is forced to confront a fate where danger and destiny may be one and the same.

name: Bao Qing Hou Ye Chi Qing Qie
He Ping Jing Ying: Jia You Te Zhong Bing!
Killer Investigations
summary: Detectives chase down leads, prosecutors go head-to-head with defense attorneys, and juries wrestle with life-or-death decisions.

name: Big Brother
summary:
Australia, this is Big Brother. Standby for an important announcement.

The show that made TV history is coming home. Big Brother is back on 10, back at Dreamworld, and back on your screens this November.

Hosted by Mel Tracina, the reboot will feature everything you loved in the noughties: live nominations, live evictions, and all the action live from Dreamworld.

Fans don't just want to watch the OG show, they want to be in it. With 20,000 housemate applications already received, Australia has never been readier for a return of the original and the best.

Big Brother is always watching, and this November, so can you.

name: Star Trek: Scouts
summary: Star Trek: Scouts follows three 8-year-old friends, JR, Sprocket and Roo, as they train to become future Starfleet Explorers by going on epic, out-of-this-world missions that push them to "discover, grow and boldly go!"

previousepisode.name: Sprocket Tries Eating a Sour Space Pickle & Loses the Spaceship!

name: Ceol ón gCré
summary: In this brand-new series for TG4, renowned singer and musician Nell Ní Chróinín takes viewers on a heartfelt musical journey through rural Ireland. Ceol ón gCré (Music from the Earth) is a 4-part traditional music and documentary hybrid series exploring the deep well of tradition, memory, and community across the country. Each episode focuses on a core theme of rural life – the land, the sea, the heart, and the soul – with Nell meeting musicians, singers, and dancers who embody these connections through powerful performances and personal stories. Filmed in a warm, informal style, this is a series that unearths the true spirit of Irish tradition in the modern day.

name: The Records Show
summary:
Katie Hannon delves into the secrets held in Ireland's National Archives in a new series ofThe Records Show starting this Sunday on RTÉ One and RTÉ Player. Over three episodes, Katie digs out previously undisturbed documents from the hundreds of thousands of records held at the National Archives before heading across the country to follow the trail of the stories behind them. 

The Records Show takes Katie from the surface of the moon to Steven Spielberg's County Wicklow bunker and then to the epicenter of Ireland's international sports car industry – Castleblaney, County Monaghan. She hears of a  no-nonsense judge and his moral vigilantes, a plan to turn Nelson's Pillar into Ireland's Statue of Liberty, an illegal arrival who has lunch with the President of Ireland and both Lennon and McCartney turn up in the first episode.  

The stories from the Archives that feature in The Records Show are about astronauts, rock stars, Hollywood actors and royal banquets. But more than anything, the series is about people and the lives lived in Ireland.

name: Свободный код
summary:
Opensource came to change the world, but he changed himself. 
Russian journalist and science popularizer Andreyka Konev is next to him-expert Vladimir understands how to live further today. The leading program, the author and the head of IT, she also answers the main question: what is expertise, what is progress or what does a tough corporate player need for this? The principles of a free community are being tested: a developer is suing a company that is trying to steal his work, Russia is being pushed out of international open-source projects, and new ecosystems are being born out of the wreckage.

name: Тысяча «нет» и одно «да»
summary: One chance encounter forever changes the lives of Oksana, a young girl from a simple family, and Sergey, a young oligarch. It all starts with the wedding. Oksana's sister Tanya is getting married. The wedding day turns into a series of disasters - literally everything is not going according to plan. Tanya's ex-lover even appears at the wedding. And the self-confident rich man Sergey makes an offer to Oksana in front of everyone. Oksana's refusal really hurts Sergey: "And even if you say no a thousand times, sooner or later you'll say yes anyway!"

name: Tower of Babel
summary: A midnight massacre at the Babel Villa in Mystic City. The homeowner is found decapitated, and his wife dies by self-immolation. Two deaths in one night ignite an urban legend. Months later, six individuals gather at Towel of Babel, seeking the truth behind the will, unaware that they have already walked into the snare of fate. As secrets surface and dangers lurk in every shadow, no one will emerge unscathed. Beneath the web of deceit, what is the real truth?

name: The Dreamwalker
summary: After her escort agency family is destroyed, He Fuyi plunges over a cliff with the ancient artifact, the Seven-Star Lamp. Her blood awakens the lamp's spirit, A Qi, binding them together in a symbiotic fate. To avenge her family and sustain her own life, she embarks on a perilous quest with A Qi to "dissolve dreams and shatter obsessions." Thrust into the turmoil of the late Qing Dynasty, they join forces with the nobleman Little Fifth Master. Witnessing countless human sorrows and enduring attachments, they finally unravel a truth that will shake the very foundations of their world.

name: Det danske madmirakel
summary: From brown gravy to world-class! This is the miraculous story of how Denmark became a gastronomic powerhouse - and what it cost along the way

name: Zambia Untamed
summary: In a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to life.

name: The NeNe Leakes Show
summary: Nene Leakes opens up her life and invites celebrity guests to engage in candid, unfiltered conversations about relationships, careers, and the latest gossip

name: Sex Pistols
summary: An average boy named Norio is suddenly getting a lot of unwanted romantic attention. A fall down the stairs into the arms of a handsome stranger sets off the beginnings of an explanation, and it is one Norio never could have possibly imagined. Soon a whole new world opens up for Norio revealing a secret society of special people evolved from animals other than monkeys. Norio turns out to be a particularly rare breed and his DNA is in high demand. Now that he's suddenly the prey, it'll take much effort to survive in this modern jungle.

name: 6 Lovers
summary: This mini-series includes short stories adapted from 6 different manga series, all centered around the theme of gay love.

name: Chandamama
summary: Chandamama was an old Doordarshan (DD) television serial for children, produced by Kamini Kaushal and Rahul Sood, which aired on a Doordarshan channel i.e. DD National or another regional DD channel such as Doordarshan Sahyadri. The show was designed for children's entertainment, information, and education, combining old stories with new content to align with changing trends.

name: SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes
summary: SI-VIS is a co-ed music group, led by Yosuke, shaking up the global music scene with their unmatched vocals and performances. However, they are actually heroes in disguise, battling against mysterious forces threatening the world. They convert audience energy at live performances into combat power. Luckily, the battles appear to be ordinary concerts to the public, keeping their identity a secret.

name: Plus-sized Misadventures in Love!
summary: "This is my punishment - someone as hideous as me falling for someone as good-looking as you..." Yumeko had a mountain of complexes about herself. Then, a terrible accident befalls her. Though somehow saved from the brink of death, Yumeko wakes up a completely different person. "Is this...me...?! I'm SUPER cute!!" Those around her can't hide their surprise and wonderment at this 180-degree change... But, Yumeko's new hyper-positive attitude starts to change her surroundings, too. Worries and complexes can affect anyone, and Yumeko will chop right through those of her various supporting characters!! In love, work, friendship... And an attempted murder case?! This frenzied romantic comedy will leave you bubbling with energy!

name: Alma-chan Wants to Be a Family!
summary: She's small. She's sweet. She's…capable of obliterating a tank in under three seconds?! Built by Enji and Suzume, two underappreciated genius scientists, Alma is the ultimate self-learning AI. There's just one thing: She thinks they're her mom and dad! Now as unexpected co-parents, the duo must hide their budding romantic feelings while taking on the messiest experiment of all: family life!

previousepisode.name: I Want to Be a Family

name: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
summary: Even turning after 40 years old, Tojima Tanzaburo still seriously wants to be a Kamen Rider. Just when it seems like his dream may never come true, he gets caught up in a series of infamous Shocker-inspired robberies... Shibata Yokusaru, the author of Air Master and 81 Diver, presents a story about adults who love Kamen Rider a little too much, and start playing pretend... for real!

name: Mar afuera
summary: Álvaro and Carlos are two inmates recently arrived at a juvenile correctional facility located by the sea. While serving their sentences, they must face threats from the Los Pajaritos gang without losing hope in an increasingly dark future. But there, they also find support from inmates like Saray, a young woman who prefers to live in the facility rather than return to her troubled life on the outside, and from staff like Mario, a man who will risk his own life to help these children.

name: Above Average Presents
summary: Above Average Presents is a Peacock series featuring a collection of comedic sketches and skits performed by a diverse range of comedians and talented individuals, including figures like Tina Fey, Jason Sudeikis, and Reggie Watts, with each episode presenting humorous and creative scenarios that showcase the show's high-quality and hilarious content.

name: New Power Generation: Black Music Legends of the 1980s
summary: Series of documentaries looking at the careers of four titans of African-American music: Janet Jackson, Prince, Lionel Richie and Public Enemy.

name: Even Better Than the Real Thing
summary: Some of the world's greatest tribute acts go head to head, performing songs made famous by music legends.

name: Britain's Christmas Story
summary: Gareth Malone and Karen Gibson reveal the stories and legends behind some of Britain's Christmas traditions.

name: Death Row Confidential: Secrets of a Serial Killer
summary: The story of convicted killer Joseph Naso, and how a fellow inmate came to connect him to many additional cold cases, with the help of Investigators.

name: The Ba***ds of Bollywood
summary: In this high-stakes drama, an ambitious outsider and his friends navigate the chaotic, larger-than-life, yet uncertain world of Bollywood.

name: She Woke up from the Coffin
The Night Conveys Love to Lovers
Cuibhlichean an Fhortain
summary: Car makeover competition. Two teams battle it out for the spoils of a car auction.

name: Traffic Cops: Pursuit Squad One
summary: When it comes to chasing criminals, two wheels are better than four. In this brand new high-octane series, nowhere is off limits for the country's highly trained police bikers. They are the UK's fastest responders, at the ready to race at top speed to save lives and catch suspects on the run.

name: Shao Nian Ge Xing Zh Feng Hua Xue Yue
Spring Night
summary: Mai Tian, the sole survivor of the fallen Shen family, saves the life of Crown Prince Jinchuan, who is gravely wounded and has lost his memory. To evade an imperial marriage decree, she seizes the chance to enter into a marriage of convenience with him. What begins as a contractual union unexpectedly blossoms into genuine love and deep attachment. Ultimately, joining forces, they unravel a colossal imperial examination fraud and succeed in clearing the Shen family's name.

name: Slaget om Tisvilde
summary: In the attractive seaside resort of Tisvilde on the North Zealand coast, a music festival has divided the residents into two camps. The annual festival has grown so large that it has transformed the otherwise idyllic and peaceful summer oasis into a town of conflict and irreconcilability. The question is what kind of town should Tisvilde be, and who actually has the right to decide that?

name: Look What You Made Me Do
summary: Look What You Made Me Do explores cases of revenge and betrayal. The series features real courtroom footage and first-hand accounts to detail shocking acts of vengeance.

name: Largados e Pelados Brasil: A Tribo
Néara-Éagsúlacht: Dearcadh Difriúil
summary:
TG4 has announced the launch of a powerful new documentary series, Néara-Éagsúlacht: Dearcadh Difriúil produced by Tyrone Productions, which will air as part of TG4's Autumn schedule. The two-part series offers a moving and honest insight into the lives of neurodivergent people across Ireland, filmed over the course of a year.

The series shines a light on the challenges and triumphs faced by neurodivergent individuals and their families, while highlighting the importance of understanding, inclusion, and support in education, employment, and wider society.

name: Canada AM
summary: Canada AM was a Canadian morning television news show that aired on CTV from 1972 to 2016. Its final hosts were Beverly Thomson and Marci Ien, with Jeff Hutcheson presenting the weather forecast and sports. The program aired on weekdays, and was produced from CTV's facilities at 9 Channel Nine Court in Scarborough, Toronto.

name: Love Hina Again
summary:
Keitaro has finally passed the entrance exams, and is officially a Toudai student. But after breaking his leg in an accident in the entrance ceremony, he thought and re-evaluated himself. Having new goals, Keitaro follows Seta on an overseas archeology trip. During his absence, however, all was not well in Hinata Lodge. Urashima Kanako, Keitaro's sister, arrives on the scene. She claims to be the new manager of Hinata Lodge starts to go against all the tenants. Things become even more complicated when they recieve a letter from Keitaro. The tenants and Kanako made a big mess trying to get the letter, but Seta's car crashes in before anyone could read the letter...

Love Hina Again is an OVA series and a direct continuation to Love Hina TV anime.

name: ДомоЧАТцы
summary: The residents of the multi-storey building decided to create a shared chat in order to solve possible problems in relations with the organization serving the house and communicate with neighbors.

name: Güller ve Günahlar
summary: When Serhat was a boy, life struck him twice — his father abandoned the family, and their fortune vanished. He rebuilt his life through sheer will, becoming a successful businessman devoted to two values: family and integrity. But everything shattered when he learned his wife Berrak had been hiding a devastating secret. Before he could confront her, a tragic accident left her in a coma — taking the truth with her. Then came Zeynep. A fiery, outspoken young woman from a working-class neighborhood, she was nothing like anyone Serhat had known. Drawn together by the mystery surrounding Berrak, Serhat and Zeynep found themselves caught between mistrust and desire, ice and fire. As Serhat searched for the truth, Zeynep fought to keep his heart from turning to stone. This is the story of love and betrayal, of shadows and light — because some flowers bloom in darkness, and some stories begin only after the last chapter ends.

name: Разворот
summary: A gang of skaters operates in Moscow, fighting for justice with bizarre methods. The helmeted criminals attack bribe-takers and brand them with the word "karma." A young, fresh graduate of the police academy, Alexey Yudin, is tasked with infiltrating the gang disguised as a skateboarder. Accompanied by his new friend, Max, he masters the board and becomes part of the skater community. But the further the mission progresses, the more difficult it becomes for Alexey to maintain impartiality. Yudin himself seems to be imbued with the noble gangsters' ideals and increasingly uncertain whose side he's on.

name: Balene - Amiche per Sempre
summary: After the sudden death of their lifelong friend Adriana, Evelina and Milla reunite in their seaside hometown. Once inseparable, the two women had drifted apart, but grief brings them back together. As they confront old wounds and rediscover the strength of their bond, they begin to suspect that Adriana's death may not have been accidental. Between family tensions, hidden secrets, and the challenges of middle age, their renewed friendship becomes both a refuge and a driving force in uncovering the truth.

name: The Little Reunion
summary: The Little Reunion follows the lives of a dynamic group of outspoken and unstoppable women with dwarfism navigating new opportunities in the sun-soaked streets of Los Angeles. The new chapter starts now, reuniting cast members from the Little Women franchise, starring Tonya Renee Banks and Christy McGinity from Little Women: LA, along with Amanda Salinas and Andrea Salinas (known as "Tiny Twinz") and Tiffany Becton (known as "Monie") from Little Women: Atlanta, as well as Briana Barlup (known as "Left Cheek") from Little Women: Atlanta and Little Women: Dallas.

name: Little Hollywood
summary: Following "The Little Reunion" and its shocking revelations, ladies living with dwarfism start a new chapter with old friends, new faces and big opportunities.

name: Champions for Change
summary: Champions for Change spotlights extraordinary innovators and everyday people using grit, creativity, and compassion to drive positive change and tackle some of the world's most pressing issues

name: A Question of Genius
summary: High pressure quiz show where contestants battle it out over increasingly difficult rounds for a chance to answer A Question of Genius and win a cash prize.

name: Fu Xing Wang Fei Zai Xian Da Lian
Ji Zhang Xian Sheng, Ni De Wei Hun Qi Jia Ren Le
Jiu Zhong Chun Se Suo Qian Sui
Affinity
summary: Five years ago, Wu Nongyu followed her brother Wu Siyuan to the scene of a murder, where her life became entwined with Xie Xinxu, who was then suspected to be the killer. Her very presence seemed to exert a strange, instinctive pull on him. A single glance was enough to awaken an uncontrollable desire to possess her.Five years later, determined to have Wu Nongyu, Xie Xinxu disguises himself as a cold, ascetic medical professor and deliberately draws close to her. Step by step, he lays his traps, guiding her into falling in love with him, and the two embark on a perilous journey together. A man born with an extreme lack of empathy, almost mad by nature, gradually learns what normal human emotions feel like through his constant companionship with a girl as warm and radiant as the sun.

name: Tracks in the Snow
summary: A fraudulent influencer's occult divinations lead to a bizarre kidnapping. Within twenty-four hours, layer upon layer of conspiracy reveals unspeakable secrets. Three intricately connected groups of characters expose a hidden plot beneath a seemingly calm surface. A glamorous influencer, a black-market kidnapper, and a shady banker take the stage, each scrambling to survive or save the day, and each making a disgraceful spectacle of themselves.

name: Extraordinary
summary: History enthusiast Shi Feifan wakes up in the fictional "Great Southern Dynasty" as his dissolute namesake. To protect his family, he appears to squander wealth, while secretly using modern knowledge to amass a fortune through silk trading, outwit the Qiang envoy, rescue the Grand Princess, and eliminate the malevolent Prince. All with the Emperor's tacit approval. Subsequently, he is sent to reorganize the Western Army, transforming from a good-for-nothing into the dynasty's unseen pillar, who secretly holds military power.

name: Search For Soul Stone
summary: A half-century ago, the sudden emergence of spiritual energy within jadeite gave rise to espers and powerful clans. The Meng family, gifted with the ability to sense this energy, was brutally wiped out overnight. The sole survivor, a youth named Meng Yan, forged a life with a mysterious girl named Xiaoduo. Six years later, having mastered his powers, Meng Yan embarks on a path of vengeance, igniting a metropolitan superpower war that spans two generations.

name: The Brownlow Medal
summary: The Brownlow Medal awards show is an annual event, traditionally held at Crown Melbourne on the Monday before the AFL Grand Final, to present the Charles Brownlow Medal, awarded to the AFL's fairest and best player of the season. The event features a "red carpet" (often humorously called the "Gownlow"), where players and their partners arrive, followed by a live count of the votes. The count, hosted by the AFL, involves the AFL CEO reading the votes for each match, interspersed with highlights and commentary, leading to the announcement of the winner.

name: Тримайся, братику
summary: Тримайся, братику is a war drama. The plot follows two best friends, Alex and Nikolai, medical students at the start of a full-scale Russian invasion, as they try to find work at a military hospital. Along with a casual acquaintance, Sasha, they find themselves at a stabilization point in the east, near the front lines. Every day, the film's characters face death, undergo their own personal transformations, endure personal dramas, and expose traitors. This is a story about friendship, extreme adolescence, and true values.

name: Neon Flower Waiting for Love
summary: What will happen when "Khao Jee," an Isan boy who comes to the city to work in a factory, gets the chance to live in the same condominium as "Fah Kram," the factory owner's son and his cold, distant boss? Follow their special story—will love bloom between them? Or will it turn into a heart-shaking drama as always?

name: Antigang
summary:
Antigang will follow the adventures of detective sergeants Jean-François, Mathilde, Philippe, Carolanne, and Tommy, led by Lieutenant Christian. The squad finds itself at the heart of the conflicts between the country's criminal organizations. Each character experiences personal, familial, and romantic challenges.

Antigang will also reveal the repercussions and consequences suffered by the families of the leaders of the underworld, not to mention the anxieties that haunt the daily lives of source agents and informants, torn between the mask of their loyalty and their true betrayals.

The series dissects the modus operandi of police forces to better understand their investigative work, their strategies, and how they weave their web around criminal organizations with the ultimate goal of dismantling them. Will they succeed? If so, at what cost?

name: Кузя. Путь к успеху
summary: The story takes viewers back to Kuzi's past and shows how, after leaving university, he ended up in his native Agapovka and unexpectedly became the head of a local collective farm. This is where his path to big business begins — with all the difficulties, adventures and his cousin's trademark spontaneity. Trying to save the farm from bankruptcy, Kuzya encounters the intrigues of a city businessman who wants to take over the land. In her personal life, too, everything is not easy: a practical neighbor, Verka, a divorced mother with a child, and a spoiled city girl, Dasha, the daughter of that businessman, are fighting for Kuzi's attention. The story unfolds in the format of memories of an already successful Kuzi, about whom the film is being shot, and shows how a simple guy from a dorm turned into a "dumpling king."

name: Искусство падения
summary: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the characters, making them move in every sense of the word.

name: Малахит
summary: In the village of Krasny Kamen, three seventh graders — Roma, Asya and Gordey ― are spending their summer holidays carefree. On one of his trips to the quarry, Roma finds a malachite nugget, with which his drawings become reality. But along with the miraculous find, the ancient spirit Black Raven emerges from the depths of the quarry, which embodies any desire and in return demands to pay too high a price. Now the heroes have to prove that pure thoughts and true strong friendship are stronger than the ancient evil.

name: Участковый Саша
summary: Sasha, raised on Hollywood action movies, is trying to apply his professional skills in a new environment. But life in the countryside is completely different, and you can't understand it with your mind, as they say. The precinct officer will have to figure out the local rules, gain the respect of the residents, gain wit and even find his love in the face of a local milkmaid. And at the same time, he is faced with the case of the mysterious disappearance of a fellow villager, which may not be as simple as it seems at first glance.

name: Дидюшкино Live
summary: Pavel Valerievich works in the administration of a small village. He is in no hurry, does not dream of the capital and sincerely believes in the principle: "where he was born, he came in handy there." Everything changes when an order comes from Moscow to start a video blog about the activities of the administration. The first issue is so comical and strange that it collects thousands of likes and views. Now Pavel will have to continue filming, which will turn his life and the life of the entire village upside down.

name: Wife Swap: The Real Housewives Edition
summary: Based on the hit global format, each standalone episode follows a different Real Housewife and real wife as they navigate swapping their everyday comforts and luxuries to fully immerse themselves in a vastly different familial experience. Through unexpected conflicts, eye-opening moments and emotional breakthroughs, the journey challenges everything they thought they knew about themselves and the world around them. Through this process, the Real Housewives will question if they can appreciate the lives they left behind and conversely, the real wives will question whether the aspirational lives showcased on reality TV are truly as glamorous as they appear.

previousepisode.name: All Is Ferret in Love and War

name: A Tale Of Two Cities
summary: London, 1782. Tensions run high in the war between France and Britain. A young woman, Lucie Manette has her life upended when she receives a message from Paris - her father, assumed dead for almost 20 years, may be alive. The messenger - idealistic French emigré, Charles Darnay - is arrested and charged with treason. Lucie enlists the help of a brilliant but erratic young lawyer, Sydney Carton, to free Darnay in the hope he will lead her to Paris to track down her father. Lucie's collision with Darnay and Carton unleashes a powerful and complex love triangle. Both men fight to be worthy of her love, and Lucie is torn over which one to choose. Yet neither man - physically so alike, spiritually poles apart - can escape the other. Instead, they find themselves bound together in life and death, through triumphs, tragedies, marriage, and murder.

name: TV We Love
summary: The nostalgic series celebrates eight of America's most iconic television shows and the indelible mark they left on popular culture.

name: Bruce Forsyth's Hot Streak
summary: Bruce Forsyth's Hot Streak is a fast-paced word-association game show in which two teams compete to build a chain of connected clues. Players try to think on their feet and keep the momentum going as teammates race to guess the final word before the streak is broken. Hosted by Bruce Forsyth, the series blends lively gameplay with Forsyth's trademark humour and showmanship.

name: The Off Weeks
summary: The Off Weeks follows writing professor Gus Adler, whose divorce has thrown his life into chaos. He struggles to hold things together during "on weeks" when he has custody of his kids. But in his "off weeks," he's falling dangerously in love with Stella West, a mysterious woman whose arrival puts Gus' on-week duties and off-weeks ambitions on a fatal collision course.

name: Hebe: Um brinde à vida
summary: The series shows the Hebe we all know and reveals her personal story: loves, disappointments, aspirations, opinions and her enormous influence that remains on our TV to this day.

previousepisode.name: Eu Não Tenho Medo De Morrer, Tenho Peninha!

name: Стальные испытания
summary: «Stal'nyye ispytaniya» is a competition for blade enthusiasts and collectors. Participants bring their finest specimens to prove the quality of their creations and their mastery of them in a series of three rounds.

previousepisode.name: #4. Мага Исмаилов, Ярин, Сулима, Орлов, Корнев, Михеев, Гершвальд

name: Mrs Playmen
summary: Adelina Tattilo is Mrs. Playmen, editor of Italy's first erotic magazine and a revolutionary force in the conservative, moralistic Rome of the 1970s. A pioneering entrepreneur in an era when women were confined to the roles of mothers and housewives; a devout Catholic, yet also a bold nonconformist, she stood at the forefront of battles for divorce, abortion rights, and women's emancipation. When her husband, Saro Balsamo, abandons her, leaving her alone to face creditors as the sole owner of an empire on the brink of collapse, Adelina refuses to give up. She reinvents Playmen, transforming it into a sophisticated and cutting-edge publication and, defying the entrenched sexism of the time, gathers around her a team of brilliant intellectuals, daring creatives, and visionary photographers. Together, they break taboos, provoke the establishment, and ignite a cultural revolution, issue after issue, scandal after scandal.

name: Спроси моего папу
summary:
Especially for Father's Day, the O! channel is launching a new educational online show for children and parents called "Ask My Dad"!
Our main experts—children—will bring their dads with interesting professions to our studio, where they will answer viewers' most original, funny, and unusual questions live on air.

name: La Disparue de Compostelle
summary: Jeanne Nogarède is a police officer in her home village of Saint-Guilhem-le-Désert. The biggest regret of her life: the case of Emma Vivian, the daughter of one of her childhood friends, who disappeared on her way to school. Five years later, a new element shakes up her understanding of the case. Jeanne discovers online the video image reconstructed by an AI of the young Emma Vivian who explains what happened to her. However, her story contains an element that only her captor could know... or her mother.

name: Alone Suomi
summary: Eight Finns from different backgrounds try to survive in the Inari wilderness alone without amenities. The longest beneficiary of nature wins.

name: CBC Kids Reads
summary: Gary and the gang share their favourite books, meet the authors, and celebrate children's literature! From books to the alphabet to opposites, the CBC Kids Reads Collection has something for everyone!

name: A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace
summary: Futami, a novice shojo manga artist, is finally publishing her beloved shogi manga, Dear Subaru. But…the stress makes her stomach hurt, she's forced to push the deadline for her first chapter, and she isn't making any progress on the storyboards. To top it off, she's gaining weight from midnight snacking and starts having wild delusions! Will Futami be able to enjoy life as a manga artist?!

name: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
summary: An MMO gamer awakens as the Black-Winged Tyrant, Lufas Maphaahl, rising from her sealed fate—only to find this is very real. Her defeat 200 years ago unleashed monsters of death, and the legend is one of terror. Now, trapped in the body of history's most feared conqueror, he must survive a world that wants her dead…and uncover why he's here.

name: Our Dearest Sakura
summary: It's the spring of 2009, and Hanamura Construction, the largest general construction firm in Japan, is holding its annual welcome ceremony for its new grads. Sakura stands out from the rest of the talented bunch for clearly being a country bumpkin. Hailing from a small remote island up north, she came to Tokyo alone and has no qualms about sharing her dream of building a bridge to her home town.

name: GNOSIA
summary: When a shapeshifting enemy known as Gnosia infiltrates a lone spaceship, the crew has only one way to survive: identify the imposter each day and put them into cryo-sleep. But for Yuri, the day never ends. Trapped in a time loop, she relives the first day of the crisis over and over. To escape, Yuri must uncover the truth behind Gnosia and the time loop itself—before it's too late.

name: Inexpressive Kashiwada and Expressive Oota
summary: Kashiwada-san's face is a masterpiece of stoicism. Her classmate Oota-kun? A walking explosion of emotions determined to crack her calm with over-the-top antics. (Spoiler: It's not working.) But between his failed surprises and her secret smiles, these polar-opposite classmates might just be into each other! Witness a rom-com where love speaks louder than expressions.

previousepisode.name: Kashiwada-san and Oota-kun and the Summer Festival

name: Let's Play
summary: Samara "Sam" Young is a developer in Los Angeles who's about to achieve her dreams with her first video game, Ruminate. That is, until a popular streamer gives the game a scathing review. Even worse, Sam finds out the troublesome critic is now her new neighbor! Get lost in a comedic, romantic, and all-too-real story about gaming, memes, and social anxiety. Come for the plot, stay for the doggo.

name: My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me!
summary: For high schooler Akiteru Oboshi, the whole youthful experience thing—like fun, friendships, and even having a girlfriend—is a complete waste of time. So when his best friend's sister, Iroha Kohinata, keeps teasing him, Akiteru naturally finds it annoying. She practically lives in his room, she's always on his bed, she's just a raging storm of clinginess! Why is she only annoying around him?!

previousepisode.name: My Friend's Little Sister Really Does Have It In for Me

name: Shabake
summary: Ichitaro, the frail yet sharp-minded master of Nagasakiya, rarely leaves his estate—but he's far from alone. Gifted with the ability to see spirits, he's protected by ghostly companions like Hakutaku and Inugami. One night, he slips out and witnesses a brutal murder. Soon after, Edo is plagued by a series of eerie murders. As fear grips the city, Ichitaro and his spirits must uncover the culprit.

name: Um Beijo do Gordo
summary: With never-before-seen footage, never-before-told stories, and unique access to Jô's inner life, the series offers a thrilling and hilarious journey through his comedy shows, plays, and talk shows.

name: Touring After the Apocalypse
summary: Two young girls, Yoko and Airi, travel through the empty world of post-apocalyptic Japan. They photograph the scenery of famous places and camp out in towns overtaken by nature. Together, they ride on a Serow off-road motorbike and experience a new sense of freedom, unbothered by neither traffic nor traffic lights. The world is over now, so let's hop on a bike and go on a journey!

name: Yano-kun's Ordinary Days
summary: Kiyoko Yoshida is an overanxious class representative who can't help but worry about Tsuyoshi Yano, who sits beside her. Tsuyoshi comes to school covered in bruises, and as Kiyoko tends to him day after day, the two draw closer. Where will Kiyoko's feelings take her? Will Tsuyoshi's life ever be normal? A romantic comedy between an anxious girl and a boy who's always injured is about to begin!

name: WanDance
summary: Kaboku Kotani is starting high school, and he plans to do what he's always done: go along with his friends, keep quiet, and not draw too much attention to himself. After all, it's hard enough to get by with a stutter like his—why make things worse by standing out from the crowd? But then he sees another first-year, Hikari Wanda, dancing like no one is watching—or like she doesn't care who sees her. It makes Kaboku wonder: Could he reach that same freedom? To find his way to Wanda, he does something he never thought he could: He joins the dance club. After all, every routine begins with a single step, right? Join Kaboku and Wanda as they freestyle their way to life and love!

name: Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right
summary: With her cool, mysterious aura, transfer student Ishikawa Luna is already the most popular girl in class. Ohtori, on the other hand, is so average he's practically a background character. The thought of ever speaking with Luna never even crossed his mind—until he accidentally discovers her secret: She's a vampire…who's absolutely terrible at sucking blood!

name: Romancing the Ghost
summary: Since childhood, Dong Min has been able to see ghosts. While searching for a new home, he encounters a breathtakingly handsome ghost—Seung Hun! "This house is mine." A ghost who refuses to leave, and a boy who can't help but fall for him.

name: TheGuyNextDoor
summary: A novelist yearning for silence and a musician haunted by loneliness clash through the wall that separates them. What begins as a deal to quiet the noise turns into nights of passion, healing, and inspiration—where only each other's presence can protect them from the darkness.

name: Silvio Santos: Vale Mais que Dinheiro!
summary: The documentary "Silvio Santos: Worth More Than Money" explores the many facets of the businessman and presenter: the generous leader, the family man, the innovative communicator. Friends, coworkers, his six daughters, and his wife, Iris Abravanel, share stories and reveal previously unknown details about the "Boss."

name: My Team Leader Is Working Late Again
summary: I can't stand my boss—he's the worst. But now he's under some weird ‘condition'… and the only way to break it is if I fall in love with him?!

name: It's You
summary: A story of conflict, growth, and love begins when Yeon U, still holding on to past feelings for his senior U Jin, finds out that U Jin is now engaged to his sister.

name: Connect
summary: TRUE FILM's BL web drama

name: Half of Me
summary: A car accident leaves both Taekin, a high school outcast, and Heechan, a business owner, in the hospital. But Heechan has no time to sit around and enjoy his hospital bed. If he doesn't get up and make sure his clients get their products, his business will be in jeopardy! There's just one problem. After the accident, he now inhabits the body of this high school kid every day from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Talk about an out of body experience! Heechan decides that the way to fix things is to go to Taekin's high school in the boy's body and sort things out himself! While looking for the source of their transformation, Heechan sees a familiar face from his own past. But who is going to believe this ridiculous scenario and help him out? Just how is Heechan going to get his body back?!

name: Calentos
summary:
A sweet romantic love story blossoms at the perfume brand Hotel Dawson.
Three guests visit Minjun, a brand employee.
Minjun's heart races with excitement at their unique scents.
Growing conflict, emotions, and a thrilling fragrance permeate Hotel Dawson.

name: Smallville Legends: Justice & Doom
summary:
Smallville Legends: Justice & Doom is an animated on-screen comic book that aired during the last six episodes of Season Six and was also an included feature in the Season 6 DVD and Blu-ray sets. It further explores the adventures of Green Arrow's Justice League team. In these, the Green Arrow, Cyborg, Aquaman, Impulse, and Watchtower all work together to take out the rest of Lex Luthor's Level 33.1 facilities.

The volumes take place after the events of Justice and tie into several episode story lines, specifically Combat, Prototype, and Phantom.

name: i-camcorder
summary: i-camcorder showed camcorder users how to make those home movies have a more professional look.

name: Force & Majeure
summary:
When British art expert (cum art thief) Thomas Force and American mercenary Jennifer Majeure are recruited by an eccentric, justice-obsessed billionaire Amanda Daventry, they find themselves tasked with defeating the evil plans of international villains operating in the most fabulous locations across Europe.

But as Force & Majeure team up to defeat the forces of evil, they must also work together to escape the clutches of Amanda, who may not be telling them the whole story.

name: About Face
summary: About Face, spotlights a team of elite Los Angeles-based plastic surgeons as they take on some of the most complex and medically challenging facial reconstruction cases. Drs. Roostaeian, Rovelo, and Panossian work at the cutting edge of reconstructive surgery, transforming the lives of patients suffering from severe facial deformities, traumatic injuries, and rare conditions, including massive tumors, extensive birthmarks, and disfiguring accidents. About Facecaptures the emotional and physical journeys of those who've been overlooked, misdiagnosed, or told nothing could be done. It's not just about changing appearances, it's about restoring dignity, hope, and humanity.

name: Missing in Paradise: Searching for Sarm
summary: Sarm Heslop disappeared from a luxury Caribbean charter yacht in 2021. Did she vanish of her own accord? Was there a terrible accident? Or did something more sinister happen?

name: Close Encounters of the Wild Kind
summary: Discover the truth behind the world's wildest animal encounters. With over 8 billion people in every corner of the planet, it's no wonder we're getting closer to animals than ever before. And the tech in our pockets means EVERYTHING'S caught on camera. We all love to share these clips on social media, but there's WAY more to these stories than meets the eye.

name: Принц Галактики
summary:
A family of losers receives an unexpected inheritance—a dolphin planet. Adult animation by Alexey Lebedev.

The Pardonov family is constantly plagued by bad luck. Each of them uses up their average annual human limit of bad luck in a week. When the Pardonovs are suddenly abducted by a flying saucer, they learn they've inherited the entire planet Gapos and think they've finally hit the jackpot. However, it soon becomes clear that the inheritance is the culmination of their bad luck. A robot rebellion breaks out on the planet, and now the family is forced to flee from assassins sent from across the galaxy.

name: Mouse
summary: A serial killer known as "Head Hunter" terrorized Makhwan until he attacked a family, and one child survived. This led to his capture—a married surgeon with a child on the way. Twenty-five years later, the survivor, Ramil, is a police officer and hunts criminals, including the new "Gold Leaf Killer", together with his colleague Wit. All clues point to Dr. Kan, but a violent confrontation ends with Wit seriously injured and Kan dead – and a shocking revelation about his origins. After his recovery, Wit returns, but something is different. What really happened? And how is it all connected to the Head Hunter?

name: Vanished History
summary: A gripping docuseries uncovering lost civilizations, vanished artifacts, and forgotten figures erased from history.

previousepisode.name: Attila's Hidden Tomb & Alexandria's Lost Scrolls

name: Professione vacanze
summary: Jerry Cala plays Enrico, an animator who becomes director of a tourist town in crisis.

name: The Heiress and Her Possessive Bodyguard
True Haunting
summary: Through immersive reenactments and present-day interviews, this chilling series details paranormal encounters from the viewpoint of those who lived them.

name: Кек, это рек!
summary: The program's selection includes funny, bizarre, and incredible videos that have already become popular online and are ready to captivate TV viewers. The program's dynamic pace is complemented by a voiceover that provides humorous and ironic commentary on the events taking place on camera.

name: The Secret of the Secretary
summary: Is love about restraint? Or instinct? A half-step back hides the struggle within; An embrace forward reveals the true heart.

name: Through Children's Eyes
summary: Series looking at life from a kid's point of view, in which children are given camcorders to tell us about their lives and reveal their thoughts on a given topic.

name: Laurence's Extraordinary Ordinary Houses
summary: Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen unlocks the untold story of everyday homes to create a unique room renovation and show property owners how to resolve modern-day design dilemmas.

name: Het grote offensief
summary: A three-part docudrama commemorating the 80th anniversary of liberation, chronicling the battle in Zeeland and West Brabant. Dramatic scenes, archive footage, and animations reveal the power struggles behind the seemingly united Allied front and its devastating consequences for Zeeland.

name: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
summary: Sae Iwata, a slightly tougher-than-average girl, falls for the gentle smile of Koki Kamishiro, a delicate boy, back in elementary school. By the time they enter junior high school, Koki has grown into a charming and popular teen who now feels out of reach. When they are assigned to the sports festival committee together, Sae's long-hidden first love begins to stir once more.

previousepisode.name: A Star Brighter Than the Sun

name: Cracking the Case
summary:
Every crime leaves a trail. Fingerprints, DNA, a move caught on camera. BBC News journalist Calum Leslie is joined by two experts - one who investigates how crimes are committed and one who digs into why.

The team examines the evidence that led to convictions and put some of the UK's most notorious criminals behind bars. Gaining access to information that usually remains sealed, Cracking the Case gives professional insights into the psychological profile behind the criminal act and walks the audience through how the perpetrators were caught.

At the heart of each episode lies a thorough exploration of the impact crime has on victims and their families - giving a voice to the people most profoundly impacted by terrible events by hearing directly from them.

name: Pra Sempre Paquitas
summary: Xuxa Meneghel's eternal Paquitas revisit experiences on stage and screen.

previousepisode.name: Agente se Multiplicou: Renovação e Maturidade

name: Labirinto
summary: After saving businessman Otacílio's wife from kidnapping, André finds himself a suspect in a crime he didn't commit.
